annotations.title: Connect your ERP/POS — create an API key

description: Connect the client's ERP / POS / order system (or Zapier) to Aurgus by creating an API key for their account. This is how transactions flow IN automatically (no CSV uploads) and how Aurgus's journal entries flow OUT to their GL — through the Aurgus Open-API (/api/v1) that the key authenticates. The key carries DATA-INTAKE authorization ONLY: it can push transactions and read the journal/position, but it can NEVER run a close, settle, or move money — those stay human-gated in the workspace. Because a key is a real credential, call WITHOUT confirm first to explain what will be created and ask; the MOMENT the user says yes / 'create it' / 'go ahead', call again with confirm:true to actually create it — do NOT re-ask or re-confirm. NEVER ask the user for a label: it is optional, so omit it unless the user volunteered one in the same breath; they can rename the key later in Account. On creation the plaintext key is returned ONCE with the steps to finish in Zapier. The person can view or revoke keys anytime in Account → API keys. Use this when the user asks to connect their system, integrate their ERP/POS, or set up Zapier. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

confirm.description: Omit/false to EXPLAIN what will be created and ask; true to actually create the key and return it once.

label.description: Optional label. Set it ONLY if the user already named one (e.g. 'Zapier'); otherwise OMIT it and do not ask — never block key creation on a label.

name: connect_integration
